rawContent: Now that the dam has broken about Junot Diaz's abuse, we writers of color who have attended his annual workshop are asking for accountability from admin. We invite all writers in solidarity w survivors and fellows to sign #VONAFellowsSpeak #MeToo #TimesUp https://t.co/s4aNb8QlKp

@comosedicenerd I also had amazing experiences at VONA, this would've been my fourth year there. It's terrible what's happening w Diaz and other faculty but I hope we can protect future fellows and really, create newer and safer spaces #VONAFellowsSpeak #MeToo #TimesUp
